description: table.place pack (.tbpp.json) — see docs/packs.md and llms.txt

scope.description:
'table' = the shared game, loaded once per lobby by the host (TTS analog: the mod/save).
'player' = what one player brings, spawned per seat (TTS analog: a Saved Object, e.g. a deck-builder export).
scope.title: scope

slot.description: Stable id within the pack, e.g. 'main', 'discard'
slot.title: slot

back.description: Face ref for the card back
back.title: back

locked.description:
Spawns pinned in place (TTS `Locked`): the pile can't be moved, flipped or
ungrouped, but cards still come off its top. `L` unpins it at the table.
Omitted means unlocked.
locked.title: locked

code.description: Stable code within the pack, e.g. 'AS' (ace of spades)
code.title: code

face.description: Face ref: https url, `sheet:` descriptor, or `gen:` scheme
face.title: face

orientation.description: default resting orientation; absent = 'portrait' (TTS analog: SidewaysCard)
orientation.title: orientation

pieces.description: tokens/pawns/counters/dice that spawn with the pack

color.description: hex tint; pawns/counters/dice without images render in this color
color.title: color

imageUrl.description: token top-face image ref (resolved like card faces)
imageUrl.title: imageUrl

states.description:
Alternate faces the piece can be cycled through in play.

**`states[0]` is the base face** — the list is the piece's COMPLETE set of
faces, not extra ones added to `imageUrl`. A piece with `states` renders
`states[n].face` and starts at n = 0 (a scenario placement can start it
elsewhere); `imageUrl` is then only a fallback for consumers that ignore
states, and exporters write it equal to `states[0].face`.

Orthogonal to `kind: 'die'`: a die's faces are procedural geometry, not
images, so it is never a stateful piece and carries no `states`.

items.description:
One alternate face of a multi-state piece (the TTS `States` analog: a
double-sided tile, an upgrade token, a transformed piece).

face.description: Face ref: https url, `sheet:` descriptor, or `gen:` scheme
face.title: face

name.description: shown on hover and in the state menu, e.g. 'Damaged'
name.title: name

states.title: states

state.description:
Index into `states` the piece spawns showing (default 0). This is the
pack's own default — a TTS import puts the state the mod was saved in
here; a scenario placement's `state` overrides it.
state.title: state

radius.description: world radius of the piece footprint (a die's circumradius)
radius.title: radius

sides.description: dice only: how many faces the die has (defaults to 6)
sides.title: sides

model.description:
models only — a `model:<kit>/<name>` catalog ref (the fourth face-ref
scheme). Resolved through the catalog manifest at render time; the pack
carries only the string.
model.title: model

position.description: table-plane position [x, z] in world units
position.title: position

rotation.description:
Table yaw in degrees (the piece DTO's `rotation[1]`). Optional and 0 when
absent — added for model sections, honoured for every kind.
rotation.title: rotation

snap.title: snap

reach.description:
How many snap-point links this piece usually travels. Advisory: lifted
off a linked snap point, the points within `reach` links glow brighter.
Nothing is blocked. A non-negative whole number; omitted means none.
reach.title: reach

locked.description:
Spawns pinned in place (TTS `Locked`) — a board, a fixed track: it can't
be dragged or turned, but still counts, rolls or hands things out. `L`
unpins it at the table. Omitted means unlocked.
locked.title: locked

contents.description: bags only — what a draw pulls out. Hidden from every player in play.
contents.title: contents

drawMode.description: bags only — draw order; defaults to `'random'`
drawMode.title: drawMode

infinite.description: bags only — a draw clones the item instead of removing it (TTS Infinite_Bag)
infinite.title: infinite

pieces.title: pieces

overlays.description: board/map images laid on the table

locked.description: spawns pinned in place (TTS `Locked`); omitted means unlocked
locked.title: locked

overlays.title: overlays

source.description: provenance: set by converters (e.g. the TTS importer), absent on native packs
source.title: source

$schema.description: optional editor-validation hint; always written on export
$schema.title: $schema

specVersion.description:
Semver of the pack spec this document was authored against. Always
written on export; optional on read so files predating spec versioning
still validate and still import.
specVersion.title: specVersion

PackBagItemDef.description: One thing inside a bag, discriminated on `kind` like pieces are.
PackBagItemDef.title: PackBagItemDef

anyOf.description:
A piece inside a bag — a `PackPieceDef` without the table position, because
a draw is what decides where it lands. Nested bags are deliberately absent:
a bag's contents are one level deep.

color.description: hex tint; pawns/counters without images render in this color
color.title: color

anyOf.description: A card inside a bag: the same face-ref grammar cards use, plus its own back.

code.description: stable id within the bag — the drawn card's entity id is built from it
code.title: code

face.description: Face ref: https url, `sheet:` descriptor, or `gen:` scheme
face.title: face
